title: Extract imap4rev2_capability() constructor to eliminate 5-site try_from duplication
description:
Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") appears in 5 places across 2 files (commands.rs lines 35, 90, 144; mod.rs line 477; and implicitly in test assertions), each with its own .expect() message. The messages are not consistent ("IMAP4rev2 is a valid IMAP atom and cannot fail" vs "IMAP4rev2 is a valid IMAP atom"). This is a DRY violation on a fallible constructor wrapping an infallible invariant.

A private fn imap4rev2_capability() -> Capability<'static> in commands.rs would centralize the construction and the single .expect(). Similarly, a fn imap4rev2_enable_cap() -> CapabilityEnable<'static> for the enable context. If the atom string ever changes (or if imap-types adds a typed variant), there is currently one production site and two test sites to update independently.

Affected: crates/imap/src/session/commands.rs lines 35, 90, 144; crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs line 477.
